caption:
A 1:48 scale coastal village harbor, and I finally finished the weathered textures on the old docks after six months of work.
She was just sitting at the cafe, but then she ended up in the middle of the dry dock and she is absolutely livid about it 😤.
Where would you put her next if you were the one moving the pieces?
